messages:
alex: Heads-up — we started seeing a big spike in prometheus remote_write retries from the k8s-service-discovery scrape job around 10:07 UTC. endpoints were flapping after the label migration.

maria: link to the grafana panel? are targets failing to scrape or is remote_write rejecting?

alex: https://grafana.internal/d/0xYz/service-discovery?orgId=1 panel shows retries up x8, error in logs: `remote_write: 500 response from cortex: write timeout` and a ton of `403: label value contains high-cardinality` in agent logs.

oncall-bot: ALERT: RemoteWriteRetriesHigh fired for job=k8s-service-discovery (started 10:09 UTC) :zap:

kai: likely fallout from the label migration we rolled ~09:50. I think we accidentally introduced `pod_ip` as a metric label on the agent, which explodes series cardinality when combined with `pod` + `instance`.

lisa: can we confirm with a quick `tsdb` metric query? try `sum by(job)(increase(prometheus_remote_storage_retries_total{job="k8s-service-discovery"}[5m]))`

alex: ran that, retries spiked from ~5 to ~420 in 5m. also `count_values("_label_values", pod_ip)` shows thousands. attaching small log excerpt:
```
level=error msg="remote_write failed" err="write failed: rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = storage: series limit exceeded for tenant"
level=warn msg="dropping sample" metric="kube_pod_info{pod_ip=\"10.3.12.45\",pod=\"app-123\"}"
```

kai: yep. relabeling broke. Current scrape_config had this relabel_config on the exporters group:
```
- action: keep
  regex: (app-.*)
  source_labels: [pod]
- action: labelmap
  regex: __meta_kubernetes_pod_label_(.+)
```
we forgot to drop `__meta_kubernetes_pod_ip` after the migration, so it got promoted.

devex: quick mitigation: add a metric_relabel_configs to drop pod_ip before remote_write or add `action: labeldrop` with `pod_ip`. e.g.
```
metric_relabel_configs:
- action: labeldrop
  regex: pod_ip
```
that will stop the cardinality at the agent level.

lisa: +1. If we need an immediate fix, patch the prometheus configmap in the scrape namespace and reload: `kubectl -n monitoring patch cm prometheus-scrape --patch '...` and then `kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deployment/prometheus`

maria: any risk to metrics consumers if we drop pod_ip? it's synthetic and not used in dashboards AFAIK.

kai: low risk — it was only added for one-off debug previously. confirm in dashboards, but dashboards use `pod` and `instance`, not `pod_ip`.

alex: i'm going to patch configmap with the labeldrop and restart. will monitor retries and SLO panels. posting PR for the rollback and a follow-up to add CI lint to prevent auto-promote of `pod_ip`.

oncall-bot: NOTE: incident created #INC-2026 by alex (priority=high)

alex: rollout started 10:17 UTC. will report back in 5m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: if retries don't drop within 10m we should temporarily route remote_write to the spare cortex region as fallback. I can open the route toggle.

lisa: also let's add a metric_relabel unit test in our prometheus-operator helm chart so the migration script can't add arbitrary meta labels.

kai: agreed. after rollback we should run `count(series)` queries to verify cardinality returned to baseline.

alex: 10:25 UTC retry rate back to ~8, no more `series limit exceeded`. rolling back the label migration cluster-side and leaving the labeldrop in place until next deployment. closing INC after 30m stable. thanks all :thumbsup:
